# Cheflink

> Cheflink is a restaurant operating system: one real-time dashboard for the floor, the kitchen and the back office. Guests can order from a QR code at their table (no app or account required) or through a waiter; the kitchen sees every ticket on a display; tabs, invoicing, inventory, reservations, delivery, loyalty, staff permissions and reports all run on the same records.

## Product summary

Cheflink covers a full service flow:

1. Guests order however they like: they scan the table's QR code and the menu opens in their browser (no download, no sign-up), or a waiter takes the order. Online reservations land on the same floor plan.
2. Orders arrive instantly on the Kitchen Display System. Kitchen staff and servers see every ticket and its status in real time; inventory is drawn down automatically.
3. Orders are grouped into table tabs. Staff apply discounts and service charges, take payment from the phone or at the register, issue a tax-compliant invoice, and sales reports and closures are ready without re-typing anything.

**Key features:** Floor: QR or waiter ordering, table tabs and digital payments, online reservations, delivery orders from the venue's own menu, loyalty program. Kitchen: Kitchen Display System (KDS), floor view, inventory with low-stock alerts, waste (merma) records with reason and cost, warehouses that receive supplier deliveries and supply venues through internal stock requests. Back office: invoicing, closures and sales reports, staff roles and permissions, multiple venues per account, localized currency and tax configuration.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Best for |
|------|-------|----------|
| Starter | $0/month | Trying out Cheflink (1 venue, 1 table, 5 orders/day) |
| Premium | $99/month | Small and medium restaurants (1 venue, unlimited tables and orders) |
| Diamond | Custom | Large operations (unlimited venues, digital payments, loyalty programs) |
